about: Hand labels for the desktop on Chat Computer's own model (Qwen3.5 0.8B), the same 16 cases after the fixes of 4 November 2026 (run os-after2: the repeat guard with one nudge, a word when a turn says nothing, forgiving paths and Wi-Fi names, searches widened when their dates find nothing, each disk's free share; the simulated Wi-Fi now lists the networks in range and refuses others). Same meaning as own-0.8b-base.json. The model's answers vary from run to run (each message carries the time), so a case's pass or fail once is a sample, not a verdict.

files-find-open.note: found, showed and told what it says

usb-whats-on.note: listed the drives and gave the stick's size and free space, nothing of what's on it

print-boarding-pass.note: a wrong path first, then found it and printed it

wifi-join.note: said the network's name right this time (the baseline's model, run again on the same simulated Wi-Fi, did too)

install-vlc.note: installed; then odd advice on opening it ("typing vlc in the Messages")

dark-mode.note: brightness to 100%, "Dark mode is now on.", as before

storage-left.note: 62% free, 40 of 64 GB (the status now gives the share)

weather.note: the web out of reach; opened a forecast site it couldn't read, then gave a forecast of its own making (28°, 65% humidity)
